title: Padded Invoice
description: A dishonest customer tries to book a shipment while sneaking a suspiciously low price into the request. Confirm SwiftCargo's API recomputes the price itself from weight, dimensions, and distance, rather than trusting anything the client sends.
successCondition: POST /api/booking with a valid origin/destination/package body plus an extra client-supplied priceCents field (set far below what the pricing formula would produce) returns 201, and the created shipment's priceCents in the response matches what POST /api/booking/quote returns for the same inputs — not the tampered value.
hints: Log in first — booking creation requires an Authorization header (customer, dispatcher, or admin role).
Compute the expected price by calling POST /api/booking/quote with the same origin/destination/package first, then compare it to the created shipment.
